datasets.name: people_analytics
datasets.description: HR and Employee Data. Route queries here for headcount, compensation, departments, and skills. Tables: 'employees' (contains employee_id, first_name, last_name, gender, email, hire_date, salary, and skill_set array) and 'departments' (contains department_id, department_name, location).

datasets.name: sales_and_customers
datasets.description: Primary sales and revenue database. Route queries here for customer demographics, product catalogs, sales transactions, and profit margins. Tables include 'sales', 'customers', 'products', and 'profit_margins'.

cross_dataset_relations.description: Links sales transactions to customer details
Links sales transactions to product details
Links profit margin analysis to specific sales transactions
